en-US.name: Jarvis AI
en-US.summary: A voice assistant backed by Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore.
en-US.description: Ask general questions answered by an Amazon Nova model on Amazon Bedrock, get the weather, or ask Boredom Buster to recommend a movie or TV show -- with cover art and trailers shown on your Echo Show's screen. Access is restricted to users approved by the developer.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask jarvis ai what is the capital of France
Alexa, tell jarvis ai I'm bored

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: This skill enforces a per-user allowlist. Testers must be added via scripts/approve_user.py before they receive real responses -- see solution-design.md Section 10 for the beta rollout workflow.
